applicability.rationale: The request names an intervention whose relationship to the desired operational result should be made explicit.

causalHypothesis.mechanism: Describe the causal mechanism or operational change.
causalHypothesis.statement: Explain why the requested intervention is expected to produce the desired outcome.

counterfactual.question: If the requested intervention were delivered exactly as described, under what circumstances would the underlying problem remain?

currentBaseline.description: Describe how the outcome is achieved today or without the proposed intervention.

desiredOutcomes.statement: Describe the observable result the relevant actor needs.
successMeasures: State how success will be observed without merely saying the artifact exists.

blockers: Complete outcome, baseline, causal, alternatives, counterfactual and evidence review.
disposition.rationale: The fit has not yet been reviewed.

requestedIntervention.rationale: Record whether this is a candidate solution, a preference, a learning objective, or an externally mandated form.
requestedIntervention.statement: Describe the requested solution or intervention.

risk.rationale: Initial provisional routine assessment; raise the axes when evidence indicates materiality.

title: Requested intervention and desired outcome fit
